summary:

The folks over at The Coalition have shared their first major update for Gears of War: E-Day since the full release on October 6th, with today's patch said to be a "significant" one that "impacts all areas of the game".

Most of this is centered around making various fixes to the likes of the campaign, Horde Siege and Versus, but it's also notable that they've made "numerous improvements" to "stability and optimization across applicable hardware configurations", as well as to "address crashing and performance degradation during long play sessions".
